meta.title: Gravity's Butterfly
meta.description: When the gravity butterfly flaps its wings, it flutters the threads of causality and stirs up an interstellar storm at the edges of the solar system.

units.displayText: Jiutian sector, Titan Base.

units.displayText: Xinghuan reaches out and hugs the mini-robots tightly.

units.displayText: Save the science, save the sector!

units.displayText: What's going on?!

units.displayText: Jiutian sector, aboard the Millennium Pegasus.

units.displayText: Yuwang closely studies the screen in front of him. Suddenly, a small change draws his attention.

units.displayText: Was there a miscalculation? Or...

spans.text: Was there a miscalculation? Or...

spans.text: Yuwang's fingers fly over the keyboard as he punches in new values, but the result still shows a deviation has taken place.

units.displayText: There's been a change in Saturn's gravity?

spans.text: There's been a change in Saturn's gravity?

units.displayText: Beepbeepbeep—

units.rawText: Yuwang, what's happening?
units.displayText: Yuwang, what's happening?

spans.text: Yuwang, what's happening?

units.rawText: The comet's trajectory has shifted. Going by its current course... the comet won't go anywhere near Pan.
units.displayText: The comet's trajectory has shifted. Going by its current course... the comet won't go anywhere near Pan.

spans.text: The comet's trajectory has shifted. Going by its current course... the comet won't go anywhere near Pan.

spans.text: How far has it deviated?

units.rawText: If you're talking about the number of entropics I'm facing, then I was just about to tell you that the great no. 1 ace taikonaut of Jiutian sector might need a little assist... ah!

units.displayText: An entropic grabs the exo's right arm and Xinghuan struggles to break free.

spans.text: An entropic grabs the exo's right arm and Xinghuan struggles to break free.

units.rawText: We were planning to use the Stellar Engines to intercept the Entropic Comet with Pan, but there's been a change in the comet's trajectory.
units.displayText: We were planning to use the Stellar Engines to intercept the Entropic Comet with Pan, but there's been a change in the comet's trajectory.

units.displayText: Damn tentacle... so damn tight... What was that about that stupid comet again?

spans.text: Damn tentacle... so damn tight... What was that about that stupid comet again?

units.displayText: The comet is headed for Titan now.

units.displayText: Titan?! That's how much of a deviation from its original course?!

units.displayText: The Ringworld's helping to analyze it, this might very well be a shift in Saturn's gravity...

spans.text: The Ringworld's helping to analyze it, this might very well be a shift in Saturn's gravity...

units.rawText: A gravity shift? Is this a Liu Cixin novel or something?! Ahhhhh never mind, so what you're saying is that the Pan interception plan is a bust, right?
